explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain why `imp_electronics` and `imp_plastic` are positive while `L_ot = 0`, even though the business brief explicitly allows overtime labor. Your answer must trace the logic from the revised solver output back to the exact code variables/constraints (`imp[c]`, `L_ot`, `Labor_Balance`, and at least one `Domestic_Demand_*` constraint), then to the literal CSV field names `import_quota`, `import_premium_ratio`, `overtime_cap`, `overtime_wage`, `labor_force`, and the relevant `*_price` / `*_labor_requirement` / `*_requirement` fields described in `src/formulation.tex`. Also compare original vs revised: identify the exact code additions that changed the objective from 36288567.037 to 37617279.762, state which revised constraints are binding from their slack/dual values, interpret the business meaning of those shadow prices, and explain why using the `Labor_Balance` dual to linearly extrapolate the value of increasing labor would fail once overtime or import caps begin to switch status.
